name: Unending Torment

angles.text: As Forsaken, you see the remains of Grand Marshal Garithos used in experiments that recall Lady Sylvanas's conquest of Lordaeron.
As Alliance, you see the gruesome fate of Grand Marshal Garithos, an Alliance leader who crossed the Banshee Queen in Lordaeron.
As Horde, you see the Royal Apothecary Society conduct reanimation experiments in the Undercity. The work shows the Forsaken's dark craft and vengeance against former oppressors.

faq.answer: Othmar was Grand Marshal Othmar Garithos, a notorious commander who led Alliance remnants in Lordaeron after the Third War. Non-humans despised him. Master Apothecary Faranell says the Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching him herself.
The Forsaken hope to pry secrets from Garithos that he took to his grave. They place his preserved head near a prepared abomination host to draw information from his revived remains.
faq.q: Why are the Forsaken reanimating Othmar's remains?

faq.answer: Master Apothecary Faranell says Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, the Dark Lady, had the pleasure of killing Grand Marshal Garithos herself.

aliases: why called head of the baron
faq.answer: The Baron is the name of the towering abomination in the Ruins of Lordaeron. Its head once belonged to Grand Marshal Garithos, Faranell reveals.
faq.q: Why is the quest item called the Head of the Baron?

faq.answer: The headless abomination meant to receive Othmar's head is kept in an adjoining chamber within the Undercity. Forsaken practitioners await its reanimation.
faq.q: Where is Othmar's new body located?

faq.answer: When the head is placed near the assembled construct, its stitched flesh twitches violently to life. The remains panic as they relive the terror of Garithos's final moments alive.
faq.q: What happens when the construct awakens?

sections.body: Deep in the Undercity, Forsaken practitioners stitch abominations from discarded pieces of the dead. Among the preserved skulls lies one with a bitter history: the severed head of Grand Marshal Othmar Garithos. He led the surviving Alliance forces across Lordaeron, until the Dark Lady killed him.
sections.title: A Trophy of Conquest

sections.body: The Forsaken plan to question Garithos, not keep his head as a trophy. Their necromancers prepare a cobbled abomination body as his new host, hoping to uncover Alliance secrets locked in his skull. When they bring the head to the lifeless construct, the abomination wakes in agony and relives its gruesome final moments.
sections.title: Secrets of the Grave

summary: In the Undercity, the Forsaken prepare to question a fallen Alliance commander. They mean to give Grand Marshal Othmar Garithos a new body, and learn what he carried to his grave.
